protocol: gallery of 59 shop.kind.co.jp listings, one photograph each; query is a different photograph of a target listing, degraded seven ways; a hit means the correct listing ranks top-1 by cosine

rejected.multi_scale_query_expansion: 23/28 at double the latency; not adopted

note: Held high deliberately: a false Real costs more than a miss. The shortlist, not this threshold, carries a weak query into fine matching.

reproducibility.detail: The headline backbone comparison (DINOv2 24/28 versus ResNet50 14/28 over a 59-listing gallery) was produced by a scratch harness that was never committed, and the gallery it used is not in the tree. Nothing in HEAD regenerates these numbers. They are kept because the decision they informed is recorded here, not because they can be checked.
reproducibility.superseded_finding: The pair threshold recorded here as an operating point does not hold on the splits committed to this repository: on held-out pairs 0.86 admits 70% of different-listing pairs. See artifacts/searcher-threshold.receipt.json.
